name: Shanjida Farzana Owishy
headline: Research for healthier, more equitable communities.
intro: Microbiology, epidemiology and qualitative research—from fieldwork to evidence.
about: Public Health Researcher with expertise in microbiology, epidemiology, and qualitative research. I manage the full research cycle for donor-funded projects—from proposals and field-based studies to reports and peer-reviewed manuscripts.

research.title: Food Security Disparities & Price Fluctuations
research.description: Research into regional disparities and the impact of food-price fluctuations on food security.

experience.description: Develops proposals, coordinates submissions and stakeholder activities, supports manuscripts, and conducts and analyzes qualitative field research.
Developed proposals, budgets and data-collection tools; conducted KII, IDI, FGD and quantitative data collection; supported ethics and reporting.
Supported teaching, assessment, records and module development while tutoring and mentoring students.
Delivered biology lessons and developed instructional materials, quizzes, tests and assessments.
Supported literature review, reporting, manuscript development and transcription, and attended Asia Shelter Forum 2022.
Presented research, guided thesis students and conducted microbiological laboratory activities.
